limits: Static prelaunch acceptance applies only to this declared case and exact bytes; not a claim that any host action has occurred.
Historical host/bootstrap facts are expected inputs, with current observation required by fresh observer; not fresh host identity or GPU lease proof.
Exact source A5 copies are verified against completed frozen/committed receipt and recomputed Git blob IDs; no Git/sourceaudit/CI review is rerun.
Only2 SSH +1 SCP invocations are declared; underlying connections/multiplexing, remote artifact durability/retrieval and physical node authentication remain unmeasured.
Direct compiler/transport timeouts do not guarantee compiler descendants, guard/coordinator/observer/host loss recovery or a complete receipt.
All seven production/model/resource authority flags remain false; no Torch/model/pipcheck/install/GPU/foreign queue/browser/external trial action.
